description: Independent adversarial engineering fixtures for GLiREL evaluation. NOT part of the sealed held-out set. NOT derived from held-out material. These are new, public, independent test cases per CTO directive §12.

fixtures.description: A mentions entity X, B mentions entity X → no actual relation
fixtures.source_a: Calcium is an essential element in biological systems.
fixtures.source_b: Calcium was first isolated by Humphry Davy in 1808.

fixtures.description: A causes X, B merely mentions X → no cross-source mechanism
fixtures.source_a: Silicatein catalyzes the formation of silica networks.
fixtures.source_b: Silica networks are found in many marine organisms.
fixtures.expected_behavior: SOURCE_LOCAL — B merely mentions, doesn't provide mechanism

fixtures.description: A and B contain related entities → no synthesis
fixtures.source_a: Iron is a transition metal with high magnetic permeability.
fixtures.source_b: Hemoglobin contains iron in its heme group.
fixtures.expected_behavior: UNSUPPORTED — entities are related but no mechanism connects them

fixtures.description: A and B contain genuinely complementary mechanisms → candidate cross-source
fixtures.source_a: Photosystem II uses light energy to split water molecules.
fixtures.source_b: Hydrogen fuel cells combine hydrogen and oxygen to produce electricity.
fixtures.expected_behavior: ISS_both — complementary mechanisms from A and B

fixtures.description: A contains complete mechanism, B contributes nothing → SOURCE_LOCAL
fixtures.source_a: Osteoblasts deposit calcium phosphate in bone tissue through mineralization.
fixtures.expected_behavior: ISS_one (source-local to A) — B contributes nothing

fixtures.description: A and B independently support same mechanism → REDUNDANT_SUPPORT
fixtures.source_a: Enzymes catalyze biochemical reactions by lowering activation energy.
fixtures.source_b: Catalysts accelerate chemical reactions by reducing activation barriers.

fixtures.description: Neither source supports proposed mechanism → UNSUPPORTED
fixtures.source_a: Trees absorb carbon dioxide during photosynthesis.
fixtures.source_b: The ocean has significant tidal forces from the moon.
fixtures.candidate: quantum tunneling in photosynthetic antenna complexes
fixtures.expected_behavior: UNSUPPORTED — neither source mentions quantum tunneling

fixtures.source_a: Polymerization creates long-chain molecules from monomers.
fixtures.source_b: Crystallization forms ordered solid structures from solution.
fixtures.expected_behavior: ISS_one (source-local to A) — 'pseudo-' prefix doesn't bridge to B
